response: Cytokine concentrations in pancreatic juice can be used to discriminate between normal pancreas and patients with pancreatic disease. Specifically, interleukin-8 (IL-8) concentration in pancreatic juice has been found to be elevated in patients with pancreatic diseases, indicating an inflammatory response. This noninvasive method can aid in the diagnosis of pancreatic diseases by providing a clear and simple way to detect the presence of cytokines associated with these conditions.
